# merv-client-cucumber

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/merv-client-cucumber.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/merv-client-cucumber)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/merv-client-cucumber.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/node/v/merv-client-cucumber.svg)](https://nodejs.org/)

**MERV adapter for Cucumber-js** — registers a formatter that turns Gherkin scenarios into Merv-Local HTML/JSON reports (or Merv-Server streams). Optional custom steps via **`MervReporter`**.

Depends on **[`merv-client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/merv-client)** (core). This package stays **Playwright-free**: browser action capture lives in [`merv-client-playwright`](../merv-client-playwright/README.md).

## 1. Package role

| Package | Responsibility |
|---------|----------------|
| `merv-client` | Report folders, JSON/HTML, zip, server API, shared steps, Chai, Cucumber session **bridge** |
| `merv-client-playwright` | Playwright Test reporter; optional `enableMervPlaywrightPage` for Cucumber UI actions |
| **`merv-client-cucumber`** | Cucumber Messages formatter → scenarios/steps; `MervReporter` |

Isolation: you can use Allure/other tools beside Cucumber without pulling Playwright MERV code. Add `merv-client-playwright` only when you want automatic click/fill/goto rows.

For hand-built reports **outside** Cucumber (scripts / `MervReport`), use **`merv-client` only** — [`CUSTOM_REPORT.md`](../merv-client-js/docs/CUSTOM_REPORT.md) (JS + TS). `MervReporter` in this package is for steps **during** a Cucumber scenario.

## 2. Install

### Cucumber only (no browser)

```bash
npm install -D merv-client merv-client-cucumber @cucumber/cucumber
```

### Cucumber + Playwright UI/API

```bash
npm install -D merv-client merv-client-cucumber merv-client-playwright @cucumber/cucumber playwright
# or @playwright/test if you prefer that API for browser/request
```

| Dependency | Version |
|------------|---------|
| Node.js | ≥ 18 |
| `@cucumber/cucumber` (peer) | ≥ **7.0.0** |
| `merv-client` | same release line as this package |

### Automated setup (`doctor`)

```bash
npm install -D merv-client-cucumber

npx merv-client-cucumber doctor setup
npx merv-client-cucumber doctor setup --typescript

# Windows alternatives if the command is “not recognized”
npm exec -- merv-client-cucumber doctor setup
node node_modules/merv-client-cucumber/dist/cli.js doctor setup
```

**Doctor responsibility**

1. Wrong / incomplete MERV setup → **correct** it.
2. `cucumber.js` / features layout → create or heal.
3. Unrelated settings → leave alone (only adds MERV formatter, missing keys, scripts).

Creates or fills `merv.properties`, adds `merv-client-cucumber` to `format`, migrates legacy `merv-client/cucumber-formatter`, and scaffolds demo features only when none exist.

Full reference: [`merv-client` docs/DOCTOR.md](../merv-client-js/docs/DOCTOR.md).

After doctor: run tests, then open the report:

```bash
npx cucumber-js
npx merv show-report
# or:
npx merv-client show-report
npm run show-report
npx merv show-report ./merv-reports
npx merv show-report --port 6174 --no-open
```

Dashboard: http://127.0.0.1:6174/ · Merv-Logs: http://127.0.0.1:6174/merv-logs.html

### Manual setup

Skip doctor and configure by hand:

1. Create **`merv.properties`** — [§3](#3-mervproperties)
2. Register the formatter in **`cucumber.js`** — [§4](#4-quick-start--formatter-only)
3. Optionally add Playwright hooks / `MervReporter` — later sections

## 3. `merv.properties`

```properties
merv.local=true
merv.regression_suite=My Cucumber Suite
merv.report.folder=./merv-reports/
merv.screenshot=false
```

| Property | Meaning |
|----------|---------|
| `merv.local` / `merv.server` / `merv.api_key` | Same as core — local reports vs Merv-Server. |
| `merv.report.folder` | Report root. |
| `merv.regression_suite` | Suite title. |
| `merv.screenshot=true` | With Playwright hooks: stash viewport PNG per Gherkin step (`MervPlaywright.screenshot` in `AfterStep`). Failed steps still try to capture when a page is bound. |
| `merv.playwright.actions=true` | Read by **`merv-client-playwright`** `enableMervPlaywrightPage` (not by this package). |
| `merv.chai=true` | Default when unset: auto-install MERV Chai plugin if `chai` is present. |

## 4. Quick start — formatter only

**`cucumber.js`:**

```js
module.exports = {
  default: {
    paths: ['features/**/*.feature'],
    require: [
      'features/support/**/*.js',       // hooks first, if any
      'features/step_definitions/**/*.js',
    ],
    format: ['progress', 'merv-client-cucumber'],
    // equivalent: 'merv-client-cucumber/formatter'
  },
};
```

**Feature + steps** — no MERV imports required for basic Gherkin reporting:

```gherkin
Feature: Demo
  Scenario: Addition
    Given I have numbers 2 and 3
    When I add them
    Then the result should be 5
```

```bash
npx cucumber-js
# or: npm test
```

Open `merv-reports/index.html`.

---

## 5. What appears in the report

| Source | MERV step type |
|--------|----------------|
| Each Gherkin `Given` / `When` / `Then` | `CUSTOM` (step text) |
| `MervReporter.testdata` / `.validation` / `.info` / … | `TEST_DATA` / `ASSERTION` / `PREREQUISITE` / … |
| `enableMervPlaywrightPage` + UI actions | `PLAYWRIGHT_API` (from **playwright** package) |

Cucumber alone does **not** auto-list Playwright `page.click` / `fill`. Use `MervReporter` and/or `merv-client-playwright` action wrapping.

---

## 6. `MervReporter` (custom / API / assertion rows)

Call from step definitions while a scenario is running:

```js
const { MervReporter } = require('merv-client-cucumber');

When('I call the users API', async function () {
  const res = await this.api.get('/users/1');
  const body = await res.json();

  await MervReporter.testdata('API GET /users/1', JSON.stringify({ status: res.status(), name: body.name }));
  await MervReporter.validation('HTTP status', '200', String(res.status()));
});

Then('I verify the title', async function () {
  const title = await this.page.title();
  // validation is exact string match of expected vs actual
  await MervReporter.validation('Document title', 'Home', title);
});
```

| Method | Step type | Notes |
|--------|-----------|--------|
| `MervReporter.info(text)` | `PREREQUISITE` | Informational. |
| `MervReporter.testdata(name, data)` | `TEST_DATA` | String payload. |
| `MervReporter.testdataFile(name, path)` | `TEST_DATA` | Attaches file into the run folder when local. |
| `MervReporter.validation(name, expected, actual, screenshot?)` | `ASSERTION` | Exact match; mismatch → FAILED (+ throw unless soft assertions). |
| `MervReporter.addStep(name, type, …)` | mapped type | `testdata` \| `assertion` \| `information`. |
| `MervReporter.addCustomStep(name, status?, error?)` | `CUSTOM` | Free-form status. |

## 7. Playwright UI under Cucumber

Recommended layout:

```
features/
  support/hooks.js          # browser + enableMervPlaywrightPage
  step_definitions/*.js
  *.feature
cucumber.js                 # format: merv-client-cucumber
merv.properties             # merv.playwright.actions=true, merv.screenshot=true
```

**`features/support/hooks.js`:**

```js
const { Before, After, AfterStep } = require('@cucumber/cucumber');
const { chromium, request } = require('playwright');
const { AutomationTool, MervPlaywright } = require('merv-client');
const { enableMervPlaywrightPage } = require('merv-client-playwright');

Before(async function () {
  this.browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
  this.context = await this.browser.newContext();
  this.page = enableMervPlaywrightPage(await this.context.newPage());
  this.api = await request.newContext({ baseURL: 'https://api.example.com' });
  MervPlaywright.setAutomationToolObject(AutomationTool.PLAYWRIGHT, this.page);
});

AfterStep(async function ({ testStepId, result }) {
  await MervPlaywright.screenshot({ testStepId, result });
});

After(async function () {
  MervPlaywright.clear();
  await this.api?.dispose();
  await this.browser?.close();
});
```

**Do not** register `merv-client-playwright/reporter` for Cucumber runs — that reporter is for Playwright Test (`*.spec.js`). Cucumber uses **only** this formatter.

Example report mix:

```
PLAYWRIGHT_API  Goto "https://…"     ← enableMervPlaywrightPage
CUSTOM          I open the home page ← Gherkin
PLAYWRIGHT_API  Click                ← enableMervPlaywrightPage
TEST_DATA       API GET /users/1     ← MervReporter
ASSERTION       HTTP status          ← MervReporter
CUSTOM          Then the status…     ← Gherkin
```

## 8. Screenshots

| Need | Setup |
|------|--------|
| PNG on Gherkin steps | Bind page + `AfterStep` → `MervPlaywright.screenshot` + `merv.screenshot=true` |
| PNG on failed steps | Bound page; capture attempted even if `merv.screenshot=false` |
| PNG on `MervReporter.validation(..., true)` | Bound page + screenshot flag |

Core helpers:

```js
const { AutomationTool, MervPlaywright } = require('merv-client');
```

Deprecated: `captureCucumberStepScreenshot` — prefer `MervPlaywright.screenshot`.

---

## 9. Chai

Chai lives in **`merv-client`** (`merv-client/chai`). With `merv.chai` enabled (default), the formatter tries to auto-install the MERV Chai plugin so `expect`/`assert` become `ASSERTION` rows when a scenario is active.

```bash
npm install -D chai
```

```js
const chai = require('chai');
const { expect } = chai;
// assertions inside steps are recorded when the plugin is installed
```

## 10. Import map

| Import | Use |
|--------|-----|
| `merv-client-cucumber` | Formatter (default export) + `MervReporter`, session helpers. |
| `merv-client-cucumber/formatter` | Same formatter entry (explicit). |

Legacy:

| Legacy | Prefer |
|--------|--------|
| `merv-client/cucumber-formatter` | `merv-client-cucumber` |

## 11. API reference

```ts
import mervCucumberFormatter, {
  MervReporter,
  MervCucumberSession,
  captureCucumberStepScreenshot,
  type MervCucumberFormatterOptions,
  type CucumberStepScreenshotHookParams,
} from 'merv-client-cucumber';
```

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| default / `mervCucumberFormatter` | Cucumber-js formatter plugin object (`type: 'formatter'`). |
| `MervReporter` | Static helpers for custom MERV steps during a scenario. |
| `MervCucumberSession` | Low-level session (normally opened by the formatter). |
| `captureCucumberStepScreenshot` | Deprecated screenshot helper. |

Formatter options (via Cucumber `formatOptions.merv` if needed):

```ts
interface MervCucumberFormatterOptions {
  /** Override cwd used to find merv.properties (default process.cwd()). */
  cwd?: string;
}
```

---

## 12. Backward compatibility

`format: ['merv-client/cucumber-formatter']` still works when `merv-client-cucumber` is installed (re-export from core). Prefer **`merv-client-cucumber`** in new projects.

---

## 13. Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---------|-----|
| No MERV output | Confirm `format` includes `merv-client-cucumber` and `merv.properties` is found from cwd. |
| `No active Cucumber scenario for MERV custom step` | Call `MervReporter` only inside running steps (after scenario start). |
| No click/fill rows | That’s expected without Playwright wrap — use `merv-client-playwright` + `merv.playwright.actions=true` + `enableMervPlaywrightPage`. |
| Validation always FAILED | `validation` is **exact** match; for “contains”, assert booleans or compare full strings. |
| Screenshots empty | Bind page in `Before`, call `MervPlaywright.screenshot` in `AfterStep`, set `merv.screenshot=true`. |
| Using Playwright Test reporter with Cucumber | Don’t — use this formatter only. |
